note: Effectifs gelés au chargement complet. Un écart n'est pas forcément une faute — l'APUR et la DILA republient — mais il ne doit jamais passer inaperçu. Au-delà de 1 %, ce n'est plus une correction de source mais un changement de comportement du pipeline : voir eval/FAILURE_MODES.md, bras B.

bdcom_releves_2017.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_observation where vintage_id = 2017

bdcom_releves_2020.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_observation where vintage_id = 2020

bdcom_releves_2023.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_observation where vintage_id = 2023

bdcom_vacants_2017.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_observation o join public.bdcom_activity a on a.code = o.activity_code where o.vintage_id = 2017 and a.is_vacant

bdcom_vacants_2020.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_observation o join public.bdcom_activity a on a.code = o.activity_code where o.vintage_id = 2020 and a.is_vacant

bdcom_perimetre_commun_2017.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_observation o join public.bdcom_activity a on a.code = o.activity_code where o.vintage_id = 2017 and a.in_retail_scope

bdcom_perimetre_commun_2020.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_observation o join public.bdcom_activity a on a.code = o.activity_code where o.vintage_id = 2020 and a.in_retail_scope

bdcom_perimetre_commun_2023.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_observation o join public.bdcom_activity a on a.code = o.activity_code where o.vintage_id = 2023 and a.in_retail_scope

identifiants_reattribues.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_observation where match_method = 'ordre_address_conflict'

rue_rattachee_par_nom.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_location where street_match = 'name'

rue_rattachee_par_proximite.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_location where street_match = 'spatial'

quartier_rattache.sql: select count(*) n from public.premise_location where quartier_id is not null

bodacc_cessions_avec_prix.sql: select count(*) n from public.bodacc_establishment where price_eur is not null

bodacc_etablissements_localises.sql: select count(*) n from public.bodacc_establishment where geom is not null
